commands.review_summary:
Adds a 653-line draft RFC for a read-only `openclaw catalog` command and related catalog, prompt, audit, docs, plugin, and node/operator metadata views.

Reproducibility: not applicable. this is an RFC for a new feature/API direction, not a bug report. The current check is process and product-fit review of the proposed Markdown document and linked implementation status.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Manual review is needed because the remaining work is RFC/product acceptance, numbering coordination, and linked implementation review rather than a narrow autonomous repair.

target.title: RFC: CLI catalog view for command surfaces
target.body:
This RFC proposes a read-only `openclaw catalog` view over existing OpenClaw command/tool metadata: CLI descriptors, command routes, routed operations, runtime Commander entries, plugin descriptors, prompt projection, audit/operator lenses, generated docs, and node/operator command metadata.

Implementation review links:

- Rollup implementation PR: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100960
- Step PR1 foundation: https://github.com/giodl73-repo/openclaw/pull/11
- Step PR2 dynamic/operator lenses: https://github.com/giodl73-repo/openclaw/pull/12
- Step PR3 prompt projection: https://github.com/giodl73-repo/openclaw/pull/13
- Step PR4 schema fixtures: https://github.com/giodl73-repo/openclaw/pull/14
- Step PR5 generated docs: https://github.com/giodl73-repo/openclaw/pull/15
- Step PR6 hardening/consumer contract: https://github.com/giodl73-repo/openclaw/pull/16

The fork-local PRs are review aids, not a request to merge from the fork. If maintainers prefer separate upstream implementation PRs, I am happy to open the same stack against `openclaw/openclaw` and merge it in order.
